node.title: Re: Pick up specific file name (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
By changing the regular expression ([doc://perlretut]):

if ($item =~ /_0828900840_.*D602BG/)

Or, by using a different [doc://glob] pattern (Update: However, [choroba] makes a [id://1194504|good point] about [doc://glob], and I should note that I don't usually use it because of several [id://1192277|caveats]):

my @contents = <$folder/*_0828900840_*D602BG>;

Or by using a module like [mod://File::Find::Rule]:

use File::Find::Rule qw/rule/; my @files = rule->file->name(qr/_0828900840_.*D602BG/) ->maxdepth(1)->in(@folders);

Update: Upon further consideration, I'm withdrawing my suggestion for [doc://glob]. As soon as $folder contains whitespace, such as a forgotten [doc://chomp], it will break in strange ways. Update 2: It's possible to say use File::Glob ':bsd_glob'; to fix that issue, but my position is still "use [doc://glob] only if you've read all of its documentation, including [doc://File::Glob]".
